name: Kommunicate
tagline: Kommunicate is an AI chatbot and live chat platform for automating customer support with smooth human handoff when conversations get complex. Support teams use it to build no-code chatbots that handle common queries, then pass unresolved tickets to human agents with full conversation history intact. It integrates with Dialogflow, OpenAI, and most help desk systems.
